title: Replace VLT cron refresh with native relative config if available
description: VLT support currently writes an absolute before timestamp and installs a daily cron refresh. If VLT adds a relative duration setting or documents a better age-gate workflow, replace the cron workaround.

title: Investigate Deno publish-age gate support
description: Deno did not appear to expose a native minimum package release age or publish-age gate in current research. Re-check periodically and add support if a documented config or CLI option becomes available.
